_comment: FX-EVT-01: track_event + posthogConfiguration + preprocess_data_properties. Transcribed from bgtasks/event_tracking_task.py:24-81. Event-name constants from utils/analytics_events.py:6-8.

groups.workspace: slug (the SLUG string, not the workspace id)

args.properties: data_properties — the SAME dict object passed in event_properties, MUTATED in place by preprocess (role key added/overwritten)

capture.call: Posthog(POSTHOG_API_KEY, host=POSTHOG_HOST) constructed PER EVENT (no reuse/caching)

posthogConfiguration.lookup: get_configuration_value([{key: POSTHOG_API_KEY, default: os.environ.get(...)}, {key: POSTHOG_HOST, default: os.environ.get(...)}])

role_matrix.admin: workspace found AND str(owner_id) != str(user_id) -> role 'admin' (ANY non-owner, incl. outsiders — no membership check)
role_matrix.other_events: event_name NOT in the pair -> data_properties returned UNTOUCHED (no role key, no workspace lookup)
role_matrix.owner: workspace found AND str(owner_id) == str(user_id) -> role 'owner'
role_matrix.unknown: Workspace.DoesNotExist -> logger.warning('Workspace <slug> does not exist while sending event <event> for user <user_id>') + role 'unknown' (other Workspace lookup errors propagate to track_event's except)

track_event.broad_except: exception -> log_exception(e) + return False (the ONLY task here returning False on error; success returns None)
track_event.gate: not (KEY and HOST) -> logger.warning('Event tracking is not configured') + return None (BEFORE any workspace lookup)
